answer: Witness-Coupled Coordination Deposits. Each agent must attach a small deposit per active coordination edge, and the deposit is released only when independent witnesses countersign the edge. Like a lotus closing at dusk, edges decay unless renewed. Because sybils must pay per edge rather than per agent, faking N identities costs N times the edge count, and witness discovery acts as a karst-like sink that absorbs cheap duplicates. An audit ledger, quartz-hard against reordering, records every edge, so attackers cannot reuse one deposit across many identities.
